name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Between Macchiato and Ristretto, one goes with Hazelnut and the other with Toffee.
Ristretto goes with at least one of Ava or Cinnamon.
If Chai goes with Edith, then Ristretto goes with Hazelnut.
Between Cortado and Macchiato, one goes with Hugo and the other with Caramel.
Either Macchiato goes with Caramel or Cortado goes with Dane.

hints.text: Suppose Macchiato went with Caramel — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Macchiato goes with Caramel.
Macchiato goes with Caramel, so it can't also go with Hazelnut.
Macchiato goes with Caramel, so it can't also go with Toffee.
…but now the clue “Between Macchiato and Ristretto, one goes with Hazelnut and the other with Toffee” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Macchiato does not go with Caramel.
